name: Ghee Cake
ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (Maida), Sugar, Egg, Edible vegetable oil (Sunflower oil Invert syrup, Humectants (E 420, E 422), Milk solids, Clarified butter, Edible starch, Iodised Salt, Leavening agent (E 500 (ii)), Acidity regulator (E 260), Emulsifiers (E 471, E 477, E 470), Permitted class II preservatives (E 282, E 200, E 202), Nature-Identical flavouring substances (Vanilla and Milk).
